criticalProjectRisks.description: Builder delays Practical Completion — furniture is ready but installation cannot proceed
criticalProjectRisks.probability: High — industry standard to expect 1–3 week builder delays
criticalProjectRisks.impact: Goods must be stored; storage cost incurred; installation slot lost; client frustration
mitigation: Always build 1-week buffer between quoted delivery date and actual PC date in timeline
Confirm PC date in writing — do not accept verbal confirmation
Arrange warehouse storage extension in advance if builder is running late
Install only when builder signs off their section — not before

criticalProjectRisks.risk: Client changes finish selection after manufacture
criticalProjectRisks.description: Client decides to change colour/fabric after goods are in production
criticalProjectRisks.impact: Re-manufacture cost, lead time extension, potential margin wipe-out
mitigation: Get signed finish schedule before placing any order — email confirmation is not sufficient alone; follow up with a signed document
Clearly state in writing: changes after order placement incur re-manufacture cost + lead time extension
Dispatch physical samples before the sign-off meeting — reduces last-minute changes by 70%

criticalProjectRisks.description: Furniture arrives damaged — client expects replacement
criticalProjectRisks.probability: Low-Medium (3–8% of shipments have some damage)
criticalProjectRisks.impact: Replacement cost, client satisfaction risk, project delay
mitigation: All goods insured from loading to site delivery — minimum AUD $50k cover per shipment
Photograph all cartons at warehouse receiving — especially any with visible damage
Report damage to supplier within 48 hours with photographic evidence
Supplier absorbs replacement cost for transit damage if reported within agreed window

criticalProjectRisks.risk: Lift or building access failure on delivery day
criticalProjectRisks.description: Goods arrive on site but lift is unavailable, undersized, or access is denied
criticalProjectRisks.impact: Aborted delivery, re-delivery cost, installation delay, crew cost
mitigation: Confirm lift dimensions with building manager minimum 5 days before delivery
Obtain written building access confirmation for delivery date and time
For CBD deliveries: confirm loading dock access window (typically pre-10am)
Check oversized items (boardroom tables, large storage units) fit lift before delivery — not on delivery day

criticalProjectRisks.description: Client adds items during installation — crew absorbs without charge
criticalProjectRisks.probability: High — very common on large projects
criticalProjectRisks.impact: Direct cost absorption, margin erosion, precedent set for future additions
mitigation: Brief installation crew: zero scope additions without written approval from TCD project manager
Any addition requested on site is quoted on the spot and approved via email before crew proceeds
Maintain a change order form on all projects above $50,000

installationRiskChecklist: Floor plan confirmed vs site reality — measure on site before install, not just from plan
Power to all workstation positions confirmed live before desktop install
IT cabling in position before workstation cable management finalised
AV integration confirmed before AV credenza installation completed
All access paths measured — narrow corridors, tight lifts identified pre-delivery
Debris removal plan confirmed — who removes packaging on day of install
